scripts.postinstall: node -e "const{existsSync}=require('fs');if(existsSync('packages/shared/tsconfig.json')){require('child_process').execSync('npm run build -w packages/shared',{stdio:'inherit'})}else{console.log('postinstall: packages/shared sources absent (manifest-only install layer) - skipping build')}"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint:sonar
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.db:generate: npm run prisma:generate -w apps/api && npm run control:generate -w apps/api
scripts.db:migrate: npm run prisma:migrate -w apps/api && npm run control:migrate -w apps/api
scripts.seed: npm run seed -w apps/api && npm run control:seed -w apps/api
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run bootstrap && npm run db:generate && npm run doctor:heal && npm run seed && npm run db:migrate:tenants
